en.bdb: The true Guru arranged the glimpse of the imperceptible     ?

verses.gurmukhi: ਪਰ ਤਨ ਪਰ ਧਨ ਪਰ ਨਿੰਦ ਮੇਟਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦਾਨੁ ਇਸਨਾਨੁ ਦਿੜਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: par tan par dhan par ni(n)dh meT naam dhaan isanaan dhiRaiaa|

en.bdb: Holding (me) back from other's body, wealth and slander, the true Guru, has made me resolute for the practice of meditation on Lord's name, ablution and charity.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਮਨੁ ਸਮਝਾਇਕੈ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਜਾਂਦਾ ਵਰਜਿ ਰਹਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: gurmat man samajhaikai baahar jaa(n)dhaa varaj rahaiaa|

en.bdb: People also making their minds understand through the teaching of the Gum have restrained it from going astray.

verses.gurmukhi: ਮਨਿ ਜਿਤੈ ਜਗੁ ਜਿਣਿ ਲਇਆ ਅਸਟਧਾਤੁ ਇਕਧਾਤੁ ਕਰਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: man jitai jag jin liaa asaTadhaat ikadhaat karaiaa|

en.bdb: As the eight metals touching the philosopher's stone become gold, similarly, the gurmukhs, having conquered their mind have conquered the whole world.

verses.gurmukhi: ਪਾਰਸ ਹੋਏ ਪਾਰਸਹੁ ਗੁਰ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਅਵੇਸੁ ਦਿਖਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: paaras hoe paarasahu gur upadhes aves dhikhaiaa|

en.bdb: Such is the effect of the Guru's teaching that the Sikh acquires the same qualifies as if a stone by touching a philosopher's stone has itself become another philosopher's stone.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜੋਗ ਭੋਗ ਜਿਣਿ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਭਾਇ ਭਗਤਿ ਭੈ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: jog bhog jin jugat kar bhai bhagat bhai aap gavaiaa|

en.bdb: Systematically, having won yoga as well as pleasures and getting immersed in devotion they have lost their fears.

verses.gurmukhi: ਆਪੁ ਗਇਆ ਆਪਿ ਵਰਤਿਆ ਭਗਤਿ ਵਛਲ ਹੋਇ ਵਸਗਤਿ ਆਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: aap giaa aap varatiaa bhagat vachhal hoi vasagat aaiaa|

en.bdb: When the ego vanished, God was not only realized as diffused all around, but also because of love for His devotees
